thread:
anya_pm: Thinking through a migration runway variant: introduce 'shadow traffic' validation + small staged swap windows for pinned tenants. Posting proposal here for quick feedback.

josh_eng: Outline please. are we talking proxies or actual live inference?

anya_pm: Live inference but read-only shadow routing. Steps: 1) bench + internal shadow (0% external) 2) external shadow (5-10% forked requests collected) 3) canary swap for non-pinned (20% -> 60% -> 100%) 4) opt-in swap for pinned with migration window.

lee_eval: Important: collect both token-level diffs and embedding drift. We should run pairwise evals on customer prompt slices and flag semantic_delta > 0.03.

zara_support: For customer comms: customers want a clear rollback cutoff and a report summarizing changed outputs. Also ask whether shadow logs are PII-filtered.

anya_pm: Shadow logs must pass PII-scrub pipeline. We'll only retain diffs and hashes for at most 30d unless customer opts-in.

josh_eng: Ops: need a toggleable routing layer support. Suggest feature flags: `shadow_mode={off,collect,compare}` and `swap_stage={canary,expanded,full}`. Also KV cache warmup TTLs during canary.

lee_eval: Bench gate proposal:
```
bench_suite: migration_runway_v1
metrics: [semantic_cos_sim, token_edit_rate, latency_p95, embed_l2_delta]
sample_size: 800
pass_if: semantic_cos_sim >= 0.92 AND token_edit_rate <= 0.12
```
Must include adversarial hallucination probes too.

jack_sales: A few enterprise customers asked about a 'migration credit' if a model swap causes an SLA breach. Should we bake that into the 30/60/90-day options?

anya_pm: Idea: default free 30-day observation; paid 90-day migration SLA + dedicated SE for large tenants. We'll draft pricing options.

zara_support: Support playbook: automated monitor alerts when semantic_delta > threshold, run snapshot analysis, then escalate to SE if >2 affected customers. Need runbooks for shadow->swap vs immediate rollback.

josh_eng: Rollback mechanics: keep previous variant pinned as `pinned-v{n}` and implement hot-switch API `apply_swap(target=pinned-vn)` that completes in <3m. Also throttle swap to prevent load spikes.

catalog-bot: model "falcon-lite-3.0-quant" staged for migration_runway_v1 (meta: requires_shadow=true).

anya_pm: I'll collate this into a PR: bench config, routing flags, support runbook, customer opt-in & pricing options. Please add comments on the PR. Thanks! :rocket:
